_comment: Single source of truth for the robot primitives. The bridge (src/bridge.py) validates arguments against `params` and needs one handler per entry; the MCP server (mcp_server/) turns every entry into a tool. kind: read = no motion, runs any time; action = no motion, runs any time, but has an effect (speech); move = takes the one-movement-at-a-time slot; override = rest, always runs, interrupts any move.

primitives.name: get_state
primitives.description: Robot state without moving: posture, fallen, awake, odometry (x, y in m and theta in rad, since NAOqi started), sonar left/right (m), foot bumpers, the movement running, warnings, and a camera image.

primitives.name: look
primitives.description: Fresh camera image without moving: the top camera (ahead) above the bottom camera (at the feet). Yellow lines mark ground distance in m.

primitives.name: look_around
primitives.description: Turn the head and return one panorama, left to right: left 92 deg, left 46 deg, ahead, right 46 deg, right 92 deg. With yaw (and pitch): only that direction. Use it to see the sides.

yaw.description: rad, positive = left, clamped to +-2.0; omit for the full sweep

pitch.description: rad, positive = down, clamped to [-0.6, 0.5]; default 0

primitives.name: stand
primitives.description: Wake the motors and stand up. Needed before moving, and the only way to clear a fall. Getting up after a fall often fails: check result.

primitives.name: walk_to
primitives.description: Small exact move relative to the robot: x m forward, y m left, theta rad counter-clockwise (at most 1 m and pi rad per call). For corrections and sidesteps; use go to travel. Stops by itself when something is in the way (result obstacle or bumped).

primitives.name: go
primitives.description: Turn to bearing_deg, then walk straight up to distance_m. Stops by itself when something is in the way. Returns result (arrived, obstacle, bumped, fell, ...), odometry and an image.

distance_m.description: m, default and max 3; 0 = only turn

primitives.name: say
primitives.description: Say text out loud (up to 300 characters). Returns right away, so the robot can talk while it walks.

primitives.name: rest
primitives.description: Stop everything, crouch and turn the motors off. Always allowed. Use it when done or unsure.
